The package **`ramp.qa`** has functions and utilities that take a computational approach to qualitative analysis, including:

+ Thresholds

+ Scaling Relationships

+ Connectivity 

**GitHub** 

+ [code repository](https://github.com/dd-harp/ramp.qa)

+ [github.io](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.qa/)

To install the latest version from GitHub, run the following lines of code in an R session.

```{r eval=F}
library(devtools)
devtools::install_github("dd-harp/ramp.qa")
```
